negotiatedScope.description: Client-mode conformance against MCP Inspector X's streamable-http SDK adapter. `initialize` is not applicable at 2026-07-28 (folded into request-metadata upstream). Resources/prompts/tasks/MRTR client scenarios and all OAuth scenarios are not yet implemented by apps/conformance-client at this slice — see apps/conformance-client/expected-failures.yml for the itemized baseline and .github/workflows/conformance.yml for the CI required/scoreboard split this mirrors.

harnessRequiredForRevision.note: The harness's own canonical file lists 33 required client scenarios for 2026-07-28: tools_call, request-metadata, 25 auth/* scenarios, sep-2322-client-request-state, http-standard-headers, http-custom-headers, http-invalid-tool-headers, json-schema-ref-no-deref. Full conformance to this required set is NOT achieved by this slice; see `phasedRequiredForThisSlice` below for what this evidence file actually gates on.

phasedRequiredForThisSlice.rationale: This is a self-chosen phased CI gate matching the pre-existing CI required-job scope, NOT a claim of full 2026-07-28 conformance. Merging PRs #37-#46 unblocks the remaining ~32 scenarios (25 auth via #41 OAuth; request-metadata + sep-2322 via #44 MRTR + gateway routing; http-* via #38 stdio + #41 OAuth). Extend this list in the follow-up chore PR listed in PR #47's body.

phasedRequired.note: This is the ONE scenario this slice's CI gate blocks on. Full 33-scenario required set for 2026-07-28 conformance is documented under `negotiatedScope.harnessRequiredForRevision` and is NOT yet gated by CI.

informational.description: Full 2026-07-28 requirements sweep, no baseline applied. Non-blocking. Of the 74 failures: ~25 are OAuth-related (blocked on PR #41 not yet merged), the remaining ~49 span request-metadata / sep-2322 / http-* / json-schema-ref-no-deref plus non-required informational scenarios — see harnessRequiredForRevision above for the required-set breakdown.
